From **“Tammy Wynette”**, Tammy Wynette was born on **May 5, 1942**, and was an American country music singer-songwriter.

From **“The Battle (George Jones song)”**, George Jones released **“The Battle”** in **1976**, and that same source says **“Golden Ring,” a duet with his estranged ex-wife Tammy Wynette, became a #1 hit that same year**.

So the singer-songwriter born in May 1942 who sang a duet with her ex-husband that year was **Tammy Wynette**.

Final answer: Tammy Wynette
